name: Lump-sum taxation at the federal minimum, Lugano
workings: Base = max(435,000 federal minimum, Ticino's minimum 435,000, 7 × 48,000 = 336,000, 300,000 living expenses) = 435,000.

AHV without work runs on the real wealth and pensions: none in the year's accounts, so the minimum 530 + 5% = 556.50.
